title: 9.5E: Solving Trigonometric Equations (Exercises)
originalText:
For the following exercises, find all exact solutions on the interval \([0,2 \pi)\).

39. \(\tan x+1=0\)

40. \(2 \sin (2 x)+\sqrt{2}=0\)

For the following exercises, find all exact solutions on the interval \([0,2 \pi)\).

41. \(2 \sin ^{2} x-\sin x=0\)

42. \(\cos ^{2} x-\cos x-1=0\)

43. \(2 \sin ^{2} x+5 \sin x+3=0\)

44. \(\cos x-5 \sin (2 x)=0\)

45. \(\frac{1}{\sec ^{2} x}+2+\sin ^{2} x+4 \cos ^{2} x=0\)

For the following exercises, simplify the equation algebraically as much as possible. Then use a calculator to find the solutions on the interval \([0,2 \pi)\). Round to four decimal places.

46. \(\sqrt{3} \cot ^{2} x+\cot x=1\)

47. \(\csc ^{2} x-3 \csc x-4=0\)

For the following exercises, graph each side of the equation to find the approximate solutions on the interval \([0,2 \pi)\).

48. \(20 \cos ^{2} x+21 \cos x+1=0\)

49. \(\sec ^{2} x-2\) sec \(x=15\)
